中文名: 杰里迈亚·拉特雷尔·考德威尔
简介: Born and raised in the heart of Chicago, IL Jeremiah Caldwell is a passionate Actor who thrives to inspire the entertainment world with his talents. Jeremiah started his career in 2021 professionally, and has grown and seen success on the big screen since. Jeremiah works and trains hard on his craft, while also serving as an Acting Coach to his peers along the way.
